'''Dravin Razorbrain''' was a male slave gladiator who fought in the arena on the [[Hollow Moon]].

==Biography==
As a champion of the arena Razorbrain received a high level of comfort and acclaim, but only until his first defeat from the hands of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], after which he quickly became forgotten.
